infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Road Dues uses your location to find which emirate you parked in and to notice Salik gates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow Always so Road Dues can remind you to pay for parking and warn you about Salik balance even when the app is closed. Your location never leaves your phone.
